issue.title: UInput loses cursor position while typing quickly
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0
- Vue: 3.5.13

### Description

Typing fast into `UInput` occasionally jumps the caret back to the end of the field, as if the component re-renders and resets selection state mid-keystroke.

### Reproduction

https://github.com/limwei/acme-input-caret-repro

### Expected behavior

The caret should stay exactly where I'm typing.
issue.author: limwei

fixedCandidates.summary: Merged pull request that references this issue, not released yet: fix(Input): preserve caret position when the bound value updates externally
